shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.footer: Shortcuts are suppressed while typing in a text field or while a dialog is open.

modals.removeAccountNote: Deletes credentials and Desktop profile. Active CLI/Desktop pointers will be cleared. Nothing is removed until the undo window elapses — closing the toast cancels.

quit.body: Quitting now will abandon the work below. Repairable operations (project rename, repair) leave a journal entry you can resume later from Projects → Repair; one-shot operations (verify, login, share) will need to be restarted.

consent.title: Show live Claude sessions?
consent.body: Claudepot can watch the transcript files Claude Code already writes to <path>~/.claude/</path> and show you which of your sessions are busy, waiting, or idle — at a glance.
consent.bulletReads: Reads files Claude Code already writes to this Mac.
consent.bulletLocal: Nothing is sent anywhere — no network, no analytics, on-device.
consent.bulletControl: You can exclude specific projects, hide thinking blocks by default, or turn the whole feature off in Settings any time.

update.relaunchBody: Restarting now will abandon the work below. Repairable operations leave a journal entry you can resume later; one-shot operations will need to be restarted.

banners.dnsBody: DNS lookup failed. This is the typical signature of a regional block (mainland China, Russia, Iran), a captive portal that hijacks DNS, or a broken local resolver. Use a provider to keep working, or fix the resolver below.
banners.refusedBody: The path resolves but the connection is being dropped or refused. Often the result of a corporate firewall or a regional block. Use a provider, or configure a proxy your network allows.
banners.tlsBody: The connection started but the encrypted handshake didn't complete. Some networks intercept TLS traffic; others have outdated CA bundles. Configure your proxy if your organization manages one, or use a provider.
banners.httpTitle: Anthropic responded with a service error
banners.httpBody: Reached api.anthropic.com but it isn't returning normal responses. This is usually an Anthropic-side issue — check status.claude.com. Retry in a moment, or use a provider if you need to keep working.
banners.unknownBody: Anthropic's API isn't reachable from this network. This is usually a network or proxy issue, or a region where Anthropic isn't directly reachable.

remoteWindow.openHint: Remote control is open for {{minutes}} more minutes. While open, any local process that can reach a session can send it prompts without asking you. Claudepot closes this automatically.
remoteWindow.recoveredHint: Cross-session messages are being accepted, and the grant record that held its deadline was unreadable and has been reset — so nothing will close it automatically. Set it back to hold in Claude Code's settings, or open a time-boxed window instead.
remoteWindow.unknownHint: Claudepot could not read whether the remote-control window is open. It may be open. Check Settings, or run `claudepot session inbound status` at the machine.
remoteWindow.unmanagedHint: Cross-session messages are being accepted, and no Claudepot grant is minding it — nothing will close it automatically. Set it back to hold in Claude Code's settings, or open a time-boxed window instead.
